title: Life in the Space Station
subtitle: 考点：一般现在时 / The astronaut lives in ...

dialogue.t: Mike, I read about the space station.
They eat food from special bags.
They sleep in sleeping bags on the wall.
Yes. There is no up or down in space.

vocab: space station 空间站 · astronaut 宇航员 · month 月 · special 特别的 · sleep 睡觉 · wall 墙

questions.stem: Who lives in the space station?
How long do astronauts live there?

options: In sleeping bags on the wall.
questions.why: They sleep in sleeping bags on the wall.

sections.title: 二、判断正误（对选 T，错选 F）

questions.why: They eat food from special bags.

questions.why: They sleep in sleeping bags on the wall.

questions.stem: Mike says there is no up or down in space.
